verses.pali: “Sahetukā, bhikkhave, uppajjanti pāpakā akusalā dhammā, no ahetukā.
verses.english: “Bad, unskillful qualities, mendicants, arise with a cause, not without a cause.

verses.pali: Tasseva hetussa pahānā evaṁ te pāpakā akusalā dhammā na hontī”ti.
verses.english: By giving up that cause, those bad, unskillful qualities do not occur.”
